test_title: PYST 38: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Opposite
solution: The correct answer is **"Antagonistic."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Opposite" **means completely different. (विपरीत) • **Example**: *I can’t walk with you because I’m going in the **opposite**__ direction.* • **"Antagonistic"** means showing or feeling opposition or hostility towards something or someone. (विरुद्घ, प्रतिकूल) __ • Example: *The Republicans are in favor of privatization, while the Democrats are antagonistic__ towards it.* • It is a synonym of** opposite** in the context of being contrary or different. • The correct answer is Option 3. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Noticeable (Option 1)** means easily seen or noticed, but it is not a synonym of opposite. (जो सहज ही दिखाई पड़े या जिस पर सहज ही ध्यान जाए, स्‍पष्‍ट या ध्यानाकर्षक) • **Conspicuous (Option 2)** means standing out so as to be clearly visible, but it is not a synonym of opposite. (सुस्‍पष्‍ट, प्रकट, साफ़, प्रत्‍यक्ष) • **Similar (Option 4)** means having a resemblance in appearance, character or quantity, but it is not a synonym of opposite. (किसी के समान (परंतु पूर्णतः वही नहीं); किसी के जैसा या सदृश) 3d:Ta39, The correct answer is **"APPARENT."**
